import sys,time,random,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M
for n,A in [(20000,24),(20000,10),(20000,2),(5000,24)]:
    random.seed(5)
    trans=[[random.randrange(n) for _ in range(A)] for _ in range(n)]
    accept=[random.random()<0.3 for _ in range(n)]
    t=time.time()
    blocks,block_of=M.hopcroft(n,A,trans,accept)
    dt=time.time()-t
    print(f"n={n} A={A} classes={len(blocks)} hopcroft_time={dt:.2f}s rss={resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss//1024}MB")
